0022600085.text: Both the Atlanta Hawks and Orlando Magic are opening their 2026-27 seasons in this game, so neither has a record yet. Henri Veesaar is out for Atlanta with a knee injury, and Mouhamed Gueye is day-to-day with a foot fracture and a game-time decision. For Orlando, Izaiyah Nelson is out after ankle surgery, while Anthony Black (ankle sprain) and Jonathan Isaac (knee sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Hawks won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 130-101 win in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
